name: Laughing Sister's Hair
summary: In Ashenvale, laughing sisters' hair draws weavers seeking its natural magic. Kil'hala at the Crossroads uses the gathered locks to make enchanted robes.

sections.title: A Rare Weaving Component
sections.body: Near Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale, laughing sisters are dryads whose hair holds natural magic. Dryads protect the woods and are linked to Cenarius and the night elves. Horde craftsmen prize their hair as a potent crafting material. Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads, spins the locks into enchanted robes for Deino's promising pupils of the arcane.

faq.q: Where does Laughing Sister's Hair come from?
aliases: where to get laughing sisters hair
faq.answer: The hair comes from laughing sisters, dryads that wander the enchanted groves near Raynewood Retreat in central Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is Kil'hala looking for dryad hair?
faq.answer: Kil'hala, a tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens, uses the magical strands to weave enchanted cloth robes for Deino's promising pupils.

faq.q: Will the laughing sisters give up their hair willingly?
aliases: can you ask dryads for hair
faq.answer: No. Laughing sisters guard nature and protect Ashenvale. As Kil'hala notes, dryads would never willingly surrender their hair to agents of the Horde.

angles.text: For a tailor, dryad locks offer an exotic thread for binding nature magic into cloth.
As a member of the Horde, you must enter night elf territory in Ashenvale and slay woodland spirits to take their locks, harvesting local magic by force.
